source: Multiplying the probabilities by values adds another dense pairwise matrix multiplication of the same broad order. ZXNAME0000XZ reorganizes these operations, but it does not stop evaluating the dense set of query-key interactions.[4, 5]
zh: 将概率乘以值会添加另一个相同宽阶的密集成对矩阵乘法。 ZXNAME0000XZ 重新组织了这些操作，但它并没有停止评估密集的查询键交互集。[4, 5]
